select
from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_CREP a LEFT JOIN SYS_USER C ON a.OU_TRADER_ID = C.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ADD FA ON C.user_id = fA.user_id where a.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.QUOTE_ID IQCP_QUOTE_ID, a.BRANCH I_Q_C_P_BRANCH, a.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID I_Q_C_P_PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, a.VERSION I_Q_C_P_VERSION, a.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE I_Q_C_P_PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE, a.PLEDGE_NUMBER I_Q_C_P_PLEDGE_NUMBER, a.PLEDGE_RATIO I_Q_C_P_PLEDGE_RATIO, a.PLEDGE_AMT I_Q_C_P_PLEDGE_AMT, a.UNIT_CPRICE I_Q_C_P_UNIT_CPRICE, a.CPRICE_DATE I_Q_C_P_CPRICE_DATE, a.CREATE_USER I_Q_C_P_CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_DEPT I_Q_C_P_CREATE_DEPT, a.CREATE_TIME I_Q_C_P_CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER I_Q_C_P_UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME I_Q_C_P_UPDATE_TIME, b.FINPROD_MARKET_ID I_Q_C_P_FINPROD_MARKET_ID,b.FINPROD_ID I_Q_C_P_FINPROD_ID,b.FINPROD_ABBR I_Q_C_P_FINPROD_ABBR,b.REGIST_ORG I_Q_C_P_REGIST_ORG ,b.MDATE from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_CREP_PLEDGE a left join FIN_PRODUCT b on b.FINPROD_ID = a.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select QUOTE_ID QUOTE_ID, VERSION VERSION, ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT,WORKFLOW_ID WORKFLOW_ID, REMARK REMARK, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME ,CB_FPRICE_AMT CB_FPRICE_AMT,SC_FPRICE_AMT SC_FPRICE_AMT,DEAL_FEE_AMT,SETT_FEE_AMT,DIP_TYPE,CPRICE_AMT,INT_AMT,SHARE_CT_AMT from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and VERSION = (select max(VERSION) from WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ETR_RE where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT T1.QUOTE_ID QUOTE_ID, T1.VERSION VERSION, T1.ENTRUST_ID ENTRUST_ID, T1.BRANCH BRANCH, T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE, T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER PLEDGE_NUMBER, T1.PLEDGE_RATIO PLEDGE_RATIO, T1.PLEDGE_AMT PLEDGE_AMT, T1.UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, T1.CPRICE_DATE CPRICE_DATE, T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode FROM WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ENT_CREP_PLEDGE T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID where T1.QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.QUOTE_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRate, T1.UNIT_CPRICE netPrice, T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10000 pledgePrin, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, NVL(TABLE01.pledStrdPrinAmt, 0) AS avaPledgePrin, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, T2.FINPROD_NAME bondAbbrName, T2.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg FROM (SELECT QUOTE_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, PLEDGE_RATIO, UNIT_CPRICE, SUM(PLEDGE_NUMBER)*100 PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM IBU_QUOTE_ENT_CREP_PLEDGE where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY QUOTE_ID,PORTFOLIO_ID,PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID,PLEDGE_RATIO,UNIT_CPRICE ) T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID /*组合代码*/ ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID /*证券账户/通道代码*/ ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID /*分支序号*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledgeAmount) pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID ,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,espr.SEC_ACCT_ID ,espr.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE =ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND ( ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} or espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012}) ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ )TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ ON TABLE01.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID AND TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID

SELECT T1.QUOTE_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 pledgeRate, T1.UNIT_CPRICE netPrice, T1.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10000 pledgePrin, ptl.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, NVL(TABLE01.pledStrdPrinAmt, 0) AS avaPledgePrin, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, T2.FINPROD_NAME bondAbbrName, T2.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg FROM (SELECT QUOTE_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, PLEDGE_RATIO, UNIT_CPRICE, SUM(PLEDGE_NUMBER)*100 PLEDGE_NUMBER FROM WFL_IBU_QUOTE_ENT_CREP_PLEDGE where QUOTE_ID = #{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY QUOTE_ID,PORTFOLIO_ID,PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID,PLEDGE_RATIO,UNIT_CPRICE ) T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID /*组合代码*/ ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID /*证券账户/通道代码*/ ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID /*分支序号*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledgeAmount) pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID ,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,espr.SEC_ACCT_ID ,espr.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE =ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND ( ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} or espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012}) ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ )TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ ON TABLE01.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID AND TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ptl ON ptl.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT EEP.PORTFOLIO_ID,EEP.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID,TABLE01.FINPROD_ID,TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID from ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, /*组合代码*/ TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, /*证券账户/通道代码*/ TEMP.FINPROD_ID, /*分支序号*/ SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt, /*可质押券面总额*/ SUM(TEMP.pledgeAmount) pledgeAmount, /*已质押质押券面总额*/ SUM(TEMP.pledgePrin) pledgePrin /*质押券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, espr.SEC_ACCT_ID, espr.FINPROD_ID, CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt, /*可质押券面总额*/ CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledgeAmount, /*已质押质押券面总额*/ CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_001} THEN espr.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END pledgePrin FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE =ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND ( ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} or espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012} or espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_001}) ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ )TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE EEP ON TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID = EEP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID = EEP.SEC_ACCT_ID AND TABLE01.FINPROD_ID = EEP.FINPROD_ID where EEP.PORTFOLIO_ID is not null
